Delicious Pancakes

Ingredients

  • 1cup all-purpose flour
  • 2 tbsp sugar
  • 1tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1cup milk
  • 1 egg
  • 2tbsp melterd butter

Steps

  1. Mix the dry Ingredients
  2. Add milk,egg and melted butter.
  3. Mix until smooth
  4. Heat a pan and pour the batter.
  5. Cook until golden brown.
  6. Serve with your favourite toppings

Nutritions

Nutritions Amount
Calories 250kcal
Carbohydrates 32g
Proteins 6g
